name: rihal-prototype-harness
description: Rihal prototype-rail harness for the fullstack Next.js template: 27 lifecycle skills, 4 tiered agents (scout/senior-code-reviewer/security-architect/sre), 14 hooks (gate-quartet, watchdogs, push guard), skill-activation rules and settings. Versioned per ADR-054 so forks can pin and detect staleness.
x-posture: private/internal — versioning + /handoff portability only; NOT published to any marketplace (ADR-054 amendment 2026-07-13). If a public/marketplace channel is ever adopted, relocate per the official plugin spec (.claude-plugin/plugin.json) and record a superseding ADR.
x-versioning: Bumps ride the @changesets flow already in the stack: `npm run changeset` per harness-visible change, `npm run changeset:version` at release, then mirror the bump here. Changelog = the generated CHANGELOG.md from changesets plus docs/decisions/ADR-054-harness-plugin-and-agent-eval.md (amendments).
